wheels stay with you
the longest.
벨로시티(Velocity)는 1985년 호주 브리즈번에서 시작해, 지금은: Velocity started in Brisbane, Australia in 1985 and today makes rims and builds wheels in Grand Rapids, Michigan, USA. Rims are formed, joined and finished in its own factory, and skilled builders complete every wheel by hand, one at a time.
벨로시티는 유행에 맞춰 매년 모델을 바꾸지 않습니다. 오랫동안 검증된 림: Velocity doesn't change its models every year to chase trends. It keeps making proven rims, sticks to easy-to-source standards, and makes sure a damaged wheel can be repaired and ridden again. From touring bikes and fixed gears to randonneuring and gravel, that is why riders who ride for the long haul choose Velocity.
호주 브리즈번에서 시작한 휠 브랜드: A wheel brand that began in Brisbane, Australia
미시간 그랜드래피즈에서 만드는 림: Rims made in Grand Rapids, Michigan

Built to be ridden, built to be rebuilt.
가벼운 숫자만 좇는 휠은 한 시즌을 버티기 어렵습니다. 벨로시티는 매일: Wheels that only chase light numbers rarely last a season. Velocity designs rims around riders who ride every day: carrying the weight of a loaded touring bike, the bumps of the city and the shocks of unpaved roads, while holding spoke tension for the long run. That is what Velocity considers a good rim.
The rims are made in an American factory, and the wheels pass through a builder's hands in the same place. Built with standard J-bend spokes and common hub standards, a Velocity wheel can have a spoke replaced or a rim swapped almost anywhere in the world.
그랜드래피즈의 공장에서 알루미늄 림을 성형하고 접합합니다. 만드는 사람과: Aluminium rims are formed and joined in the factory in Grand Rapids. A rim where the people who make it and the people who ride it are close.
기계가 아닌 사람의 손으로 텐션을 맞추고, 스트레스 릴리프를 거쳐 다시: Tension is set by human hands, not machines, then stress-relieved and checked again. That is why they stay true for so long.
독자 규격 대신 표준 스포크와 허브. 여행 중 어느 작은 자전거 가게에서: Standard spokes and hubs instead of proprietary parts. A wheel any small bike shop can fix on the road.
블랙과 실버만이 아닙니다. 프레임에 맞춰 림 컬러를 고르는 즐거움은 벨로: Not just black and silver. Choosing a rim colour to match your frame has become a defining part of Velocity culture.
From road to touring and gravel. A pair of rims for the way you ride.
넓은 23mm 폭의 튜브리스 레디 로드 림. 데일리 로드와 랜도너, 가벼: A wide 23 mm tubeless-ready road rim. For daily road riding, randonneuring and light touring.
30mm 높이의 V 단면 림. 픽스드 기어와 도시 라이딩에서 오래 사랑받: A 30 mm deep V-section rim. Velocity's icon, long loved for fixed-gear and city riding.
짐을 가득 실은 투어링과 탠덤을 위한 더블월 림. 무게보다 내구성을 먼저: A double-wall rim for fully loaded touring and tandems. Durability comes before weight.
넓은 타이어를 위한 디스크 전용 튜브리스 레디 림. 그래블과 바이크패킹,: A disc-only, tubeless-ready rim for wide tyres. Gravel, bikepacking and trail.

Before wide rims were the norm,
the A23 was already wide.
A23은 이름 그대로 23mm 폭의 로드 림입니다. 좁은 림이 표준이던: As the name suggests, the A23 is a 23 mm wide road rim. Back when narrow rims were standard, it showed that a wider rim supports the tyre better and rolls more comfortably and efficiently at the same pressure. Today it is the benchmark daily road rim, best matched with 25 to 32 mm tyres.
비대칭 단면 설계로 뒷바퀴 좌우 스포크 텐션 차이를 줄였고, 튜브리스 레: An asymmetric profile reduces the difference in spoke tension between the two sides of a rear wheel, and the tubeless-ready design lets you ride without tubes. Light without being pared down too far, it can be trusted for long randonnées and light loaded touring.
넓은 림 폭이 타이어를 둥글게 세워 접지면을 안정시키고, 낮은 공기압에서: The wide rim gives the tyre a rounder shape and a more stable contact patch, keeping cornering composed even at lower pressures.
튜브리스 테이프와 밸브만 더하면 튜브 없이 탈 수 있습니다. 펑크 걱정을: Add tubeless tape and valves and you can ride without tubes. Fewer flats, lower pressures, more comfort.
스포크 구멍을 한쪽으로 옮긴 비대칭 단면으로 뒷바퀴 좌우 텐션을 고르게: An asymmetric profile with offset spoke holes evens out left and right tension on the rear wheel. The wheel is stiffer and lasts longer.
한눈에 알아보는 V 단면,<br/>도시의 픽스드 기어가<br/>사랑한 림:
An instantly recognisable V-section,
the rim loved by
urban fixed gear.
딥 브이는 30mm 높이의 V자 단면을 가진 림입니다. 높은 단면이 림을: The Deep V is a rim with a 30 mm deep V-shaped profile. The tall section makes the rim stiff enough to handle skids, jumps and rough city riding, and a single wheel is enough to change the look of a bike. Messengers and fixed-gear riders found it first, and it remains the go-to rim for track bikes and singlespeeds.
딥 브이를 고르는 또 하나의 즐거움은 컬러입니다. 블랙과 실버는 물론,: Another joy of the Deep V is colour. Beyond black and silver, a range of anodised colours lets you match your frame or deliberately contrast it, for a pair that is yours alone.

Finish your bike

림 컬러는 생각보다 자전거 전체의 인상을 크게 바꿉니다. 벨로시티는 오래: Rim colour changes the look of a whole bike more than you might think. Velocity has long made rims in a variety of anodised colours, and the moment you choose a colour, even the same model becomes a one-of-a-kind wheel.
현재 주문 가능한 컬러와 홀 수는 시기에 따라 달라집니다. 루비워크샵에서: Available colours and drillings vary over time. Rubi Workshop can check stock and incoming shipments for you.

블랙, 실버 외 다양한 아노다이징 컬러: Black, silver and a range of anodised colours
다이애드는 투어링과 탠덤을 위해 만든 더블월 림입니다. 패니어를 가득 단: The Dyad is a double-wall rim built for touring and tandems. It is designed for the bikes that put the heaviest loads on their wheels, like touring bikes with full panniers and tandems carrying two riders. A sturdy profile and generous wall thickness hold spoke tension for the long run and keep the wheel true through long journeys.
무게를 몇 그램 줄이는 것보다, 여행 한가운데에서 휠을 걱정하지 않는 것: Not having to worry about your wheels in the middle of a trip matters more than saving a few grams. The Dyad is a rim for that kind of rider.

Where the pavement ends,
the real road begins.
블런트 SS는 넓은 타이어를 위한 디스크 전용 림입니다. 브레이크 트랙이: The Blunt SS is a disc-only rim for wide tyres. A disc-specific profile with no brake track saves weight, and the wide inner width holds the shape of gravel and MTB tyres steadily. Being tubeless ready, it lets you roll smoothly over rough surfaces at low pressures.
짐을 실은 바이크패킹, 자갈길의 그래블 라이드, 숲속의 트레일까지. 가볍: From loaded bikepacking to gravel rides and forest trails. Light, yet hard to bend on rough ground: an off-road rim true to Velocity.

From rims to hubs and spokes,
a pair of wheels
made for the way you ride.
루비워크샵은 벨로시티 림으로 커스텀 휠을 짭니다. 어떤 길을 얼마나 타는: Rubi Workshop builds custom wheels with Velocity rims. We start by listening: what roads you ride and how much, the weight of rider and luggage, and the tyre width you want. Then we choose the rim, hub, spoke count and lacing pattern together. Every finished wheel is evenly tensioned and stress-relieved before it leaves the shop.
라이딩 스타일과 자전거, 타이어 폭, 브레이크 방식, 예산을 듣고 맞는: We listen to your riding style, bike, tyre width, brake type and budget, and recommend the right rim.
림 모델과 컬러, 허브, 스포크 종류와 수, 니플 컬러까지 한 쌍의 구성: Rim model and colour, hub, spoke type and count, even nipple colour: we decide the full spec of your pair.
숙련된 미캐닉이 손으로 휠을 짜고, 텐션 측정과 스트레스 릴리프를 반복해: An experienced mechanic laces the wheels by hand, repeating tension measurement and stress relief until everything is even.
장착과 타이어 세팅까지 마치고, 처음 길들인 뒤에는 텐션과 휠 흔들림을: We fit the wheels and set up the tyres, and after the break-in period we check tension and true again.

From a small wheel shop in Australia
to a rim factory in Michigan:
the Velocity story.
1985년 호주 브리즈번에서 시작한 벨로시티는 미국으로 건너와 미시간주: Founded in Brisbane, Australia in 1985, Velocity crossed to the United States and settled in Grand Rapids, Michigan, where it began making its own rims. Not flashy, but wheels that everyday riders trust for years. That is the way Velocity has always worked.
호주 브리즈번에서 벨로시티가 시작됩니다. 라이더를 위한 튼튼한 림과 휠을: Velocity begins in Brisbane, Australia. The starting point was making strong rims and wheels for riders.
V자 단면의 딥 브이가 메신저와 픽스드 기어 라이더들 사이에서 상징이 됩: The V-section Deep V becomes a symbol among messengers and fixed-gear riders. It was the beginning of colourful rims.
벨로시티 USA가 미시간주 그랜드래피즈에 자리를 잡고, 북미 라이더들을: Velocity USA settles in Grand Rapids, Michigan and begins building wheels for North American riders.
그랜드래피즈 공장에서 림을 직접 만들기 시작합니다. 림 생산부터 휠 빌드: Velocity begins making its own rims in the Grand Rapids factory. From rim production to wheel building, everything happens under one roof.
넓은 림의 장점을 일찍 알아본 벨로시티는 A23과 블런트 시리즈로 로드와: Quick to see the benefits of wider rims, Velocity leads the wide-rim movement on road and off-road with the A23 and the Blunt series.
Velocity rims and custom wheel builds are now available at Rubi Workshop.
휠은 자전거와 타는 사람에 맞춰야 합니다. 루비워크샵에서 벨로시티 림을: Wheels should be matched to the bike and the rider. See Velocity rims in person at Rubi Workshop, and we will decide together on the rims and build that suit your bike and riding style.
